bootstrap.method: circular 20-trading-day block bootstrap from the candidate daily return sequence

candidate.portfolio: 60d inverse-vol risk parity A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], monthly; no leverage

classification: preregistered holding-experience and random-path audit of the frozen R312/R314 candidate; no parameter search
decision_rule: D1 + G1-G7 all pass -> candidate retains paper-review status with acceptable random-year profile. Any failure -> record holding-experience weakness; do not change parameters after seeing results.

gates.D1: > = 1,300 daily returns; 1,000 deterministic paths generated; no NaN/infinite return
gates.G8: calendar 2022-2025 each report; total monthly win rate is descriptive, not gating

known_limitations: Block bootstrap reuses historical returns and cannot create new regimes.
Overlapping history and current factor snapshots remain.
R40 is a local research snapshot and canonical data drift remains unresolved.
Bootstrap is a risk diagnostic, not independent alpha confirmation.
